block_participation.day_volume_source: darkpool print `volume` (consolidated day volume at the latest print)

walls_crosscheck.source: greek-exposure/strike (OI basis, greeks as of the open)

flow_iv.note: history = earlier completed sessions from history/flow_iv (kept since 2026-09-28); missing days were not recorded

definition.dp_pct: dark_pool_volume / (dark_pool_volume + regular_volume) per UW price bucket
definition.top8: 8 buckets with the most dark_pool_volume in the window
definition.windows: 1D = window_end, 2D / 3D = last 2 / 3 sessions, 1W = last 5 sessions, 1M = last 21 sessions (bucket volumes summed)
definition.poc: bucket with the most dark_pool_volume in the window (dominant grey node)
definition.snapshots: single sessions: window_end, 5 and 21 sessions earlier

notes: UW dark pool feed only carries prints with premium >= $100k

option-trades.reason: option-trades only serves the latest trading day (2026-10-16); see flow-alerts / flow-per-strike / net-prem-ticks for 2026-10-13

data.note: row picked by date == D (max date), never by position

notes: FINRA short interest lags; 13 calendar days behind 2026-10-13
UW lit feed only carries large prints (not the full lit tape)

derived.hv20_definition: annualized stdev of the last 20 daily log returns (close to close) x sqrt(252)

bars_4h.definition: RTH only; AM = 09:30-13:30 ET, PM = 13:30-16:00 ET; n5m = 5m bars (48 / 30 when complete)

data.note: curr_oi vs last_oi, with the prior session's ask/bid volume on the same row (SHORT_ENGINE §6.2)

notes: chain depth from the live chain of 2026-10-16 (a past date has no chain snapshot); used only for the THIN check

chain_depth.definition: valid contract = volume > 0, last tape on D (NY), nbbo_bid > 0 and nbbo_ask > 0; nstrk = distinct strikes with a valid call or put, all expiries (THIN = nstrk < thin_below)
chain_depth.note: chain depth from the live chain of 2026-10-16 (a past date has no chain snapshot); used only for the THIN check

data.definition: iv30 = UW implied_volatility (30 calendar days) on date; rv21_trailing = UW realized_volatility (21 sessions) keyed to the window's last day

data.note: AVAR = call vs put IV asymmetry (upside-tail proxy); VWKS = volume-weighted strike vs spot

unusualness.reason: endpoint has no date parameter; only the latest day (2026-10-16)

data.note: call_txn / put_txn = opening-buy transaction counts (Nasdaq Options Pulse)
risk_reversal = collar shape; vertical / diagonal / calendar = roll shapes
open-interest basis; cross-check for gex-levels (vol basis by default); dex = UW call_delta / put_delta per strike
FINRA off-exchange vs Nasdaq lit only (UW); second view on darkpool-levels
strike parsed from the OCC symbol

data.selection: unexpired only: top 3 OI increases, top 2 decreases, largest-OI contract at call_wall / put_wall

data.note: risk_reversal = put IV - call IV at matching |delta|

grafted.option-contracts.chain_depth: chain depth from the live chain of 2026-10-16 (a past date has no chain snapshot); used only for the THIN check
